newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks plumment to 56-month-low close.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks plumment to 56-month-low close.

text.p: Investors unloaded key stocks on concerns of weak baht and on comments by the central bank governor that some finance firms faced short-term liquidity problems, driving the index down 3.39 percent on Thursday.
The SET index finished 3.39 percent or 24.51 points lower at 698.06. It was the lowest close since June 4, 1992, when the index finished at 684.75.
